_comment: THE listing copy, for BOTH stores (`docs/deployment.md`, "Listing metadata"). scripts/resolve-deployment.py renders
it into App Store Connect's files (build/metadata/app-info, build/metadata/version/current) and Google Play's
Placeholders: {{domain}} is the resolved deployment's domain; every other {{word}} is looked up in `words`, which
gives each store its own wording (an unknown word, or one missing for a store, fails the render). `apple` and
`play` hold the fields only one store has. Limits are checked in ci.yml's `metadata` gate: Play's title <=30,
shortDescription <=80, description <=4000; Apple's by `asc metadata validate`.
name: SnapSync Photos
description:
The easy way to share photos from any trip or get-together.

Start the event as the trip begins, and everyone's photos land in everyone's library as you go — no waiting until you're home. Scan the QR code to join: your photos flow to the group, and the group's flow to you, right in your {{gallery}}. No group chats, no "can you send me those."

No account. No sign-up. If you can scan a code, you're in — nobody gets left out.

And every photo arrives at full quality, exactly as it was taken — not the shrunk-down version a messaging app sends.

Great for trips and weekends away, weddings, birthdays, and parties — any time a group takes photos and everyone wants them all.

apple.subtitle: Group photos, shared instantly
apple.promotionalText: Start an event, share the QR, and everyone's photos land in your library as the trip happens — full quality, no account, no group chats.

play.shortDescription: Every photo from the trip, in everyone's gallery. No account — just scan a QR.
